dreamteamer.title: Contacts
dreamteamer.description: The people the operator deals with (`contacts`) and the organisations they belong to (`companies`) — enriched from LinkedIn through a batched, containerised MCP session (`scraping-contacts`, `/scrape-contact`), tagged by the workspace's own vocabulary (`working-with-tags`). Avatars and logos are `assets`; a contact's latest meeting is a peer reference into `meetings`, so this module works without the meeting chain and joins it when present.
